name: Vita Resources NL
summary: Vita Resources NL explores and evaluates mineral properties in Australia, Chile, Sweden and Canada, seeking copper, gold and rare earth elements. It fully owns the Battery Metals Projects and the Morrissey project in Western Australia, and also holds the ICE project in Yukon, the Ninnis project in the Northern Goldfields, and Gyttorp in Sweden's Bergslagen district. It was formerly Bastion Minerals Limited.
